english.meaning: written-style word placed before a verb to mean 'that which is ...ed', as in 所擁有 (what is owned)
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: H-shares generally refer to assets and businesses owned by the Chinese state.
exampleSentences.traditional: H股泛指中國國家所擁有嘅資產同埋業務。
